name: Table
dimensions: Height 74.5 cm; Length 180 cm; Depth 54 cm
summary: In traditional Chinese furniture, a table with set-in legs like this is known as ‘an’. A contrasting type is the plain wooden table known as 'zhuo', meaning a table with legs at the corners. Both categories of Chinese table had numerous uses and so cannot be classified by function. Plain rectangular
